title: Senior Product Manager
jd_text:
Airbnb is seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager to lead our Host Experience team.

About the role:
You'll own the product strategy and roadmap for features that help millions of hosts around the world manage their listings and provide great experiences for guests. This role requires strong analytical skills, user empathy, and the ability to drive consensus across engineering, design, and business stakeholders.

What you'll do:
- Define product vision and strategy for host-facing tools and workflows
- Lead cross-functional team of 10+ engineers and designers through full product lifecycle
- Conduct user research and data analysis to identify opportunities and validate solutions
- Write detailed PRDs and user stories with clear success metrics
- Manage product roadmap balancing business goals, user needs, and technical constraints
- Present product updates and recommendations to executive leadership
- Partner with data science team to analyze A/B test results and user behavior
- Collaborate with international teams across 15+ countries

Required qualifications:
- 5+ years of product management experience, preferably in consumer tech
- Track record of shipping successful products that drove meaningful business impact
- Strong analytical skills with experience using SQL, data visualization tools
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities
- Experience leading cross-functional teams through ambiguous problems
- User-centric mindset with experience conducting user research
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business, Design, or related field

Preferred qualifications:
- MBA or advanced degree
- Experience in marketplace or two-sided platform products
- Experience with internationalization and localization
- Technical background or ability to collaborate closely with engineers
- Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies

What we offer:
- Competitive compensation ($160K - $220K + equity)
- Annual Airbnb travel credit
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- 401(k) matching
- Flexible work arrangements
- Professional development budget

Airbnb is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workplace.
